thread:
nina.hr: Heads up — converting Devon (EMEA) from IC -> Manager starting 2025-02-03. Hiring mgr requested LTI eligibility and clarification on tax withholding since Devon is UK-based.
devon: hi all — curious about whether LTI kicks in immediately when title changes, and if pension/employer NI contributions change mid-cycle. Also any pruning to probation period?
anya: Congrats! Two quick facts: 1) LTI eligibility depends on band and whether the comp panel approves grant at conversion; often we defer to next quarterly grant window unless panel approves off-cycle. 2) UK payroll rules: employer NI/pension calculations update from effective date but contribution cycles may require payroll team coordination.
totalrewards: For LTI — submit a formal grant request with proposed target percent and reason. If manager conversion includes a band increase >= one full band, we can usually approve off-cycle LTI; otherwise we recommend next cycle. Provide `proposed_percent`, `justification`, and `panel_approver`.
anya: Also confirm whether this is a title-only change or includes base increase. If base changes, we need `effective_date` and `submit_before_cutoff` to avoid proration surprises. For international hires, base changes can impact tax brackets and benefits enrollment windows.
devon: It's base increase from £85,000 -> £95,000 GBP and title change. Effective date requested 2025-02-03. No immediate equity ask, but manager wants LTI conversation.
nina.hr: Ok. Steps: 1) Create comp-change ticket in HRIS w/ `employee_id`, `currency=GBP`, `new_base=95000`, `effective_date=2025-02-03`, attach approval thread. 2) Create LTI grant request (separate) if manager wants off-cycle consideration. 3) Notify payroll-UK for NI/pension timing.
devon: If we submit after UK payroll cutoff will it be retro? How does proration work for monthly UK payroll?
payroll-bot: UK payroll cutoff for Feb run: 2025-01-23 17:00 GMT. Changes after cutoff are usually applied in next month and prorated for days worked under new salary. Employer pension enrolment windows may require mid-month adjustments—please include `pension_change=true` if applicable.
anya: If you need full-month salary for Feb (not prorated), submit before cutoff and mark `process_by_cutoff=true`. If not possible, we can process as a retro for the Feb payroll but expect pro-rated pay in March.
totalrewards: For tax withholding changes, Devon's emergency tax code previously flagged — payroll will need new starter documentation if we change payroll country settings. Also, if base crosses higher rate threshold, advise Dev to check tax planner.
nina.hr: Also note probation/management ramp: we typically keep a 3-month new-manager probation checkpoint. That doesn't affect comp but is noted on job profile. Please add `probation_checkpoint=2025-05-03` to the HRIS notes.
devon: Got it. I'll open the HRIS comp ticket and the LTI request. One more Q: Does manager conversion affect existing spot bonuses or FY25 target bonus eligibility?
anya: FY25 bonus eligibility: depends on plan mapping date. If effective_date is within performance year, eligibility pro-rates unless plan language states otherwise. If the manager role has a different target, pro-rate applies. Put `bonus_policy_check=true` on the ticket and total rewards will confirm.
payroll-bot: Ticket 912345 created for employee UK-3301, status: awaiting approvals. Includes flags: pension_change=true, bonus_policy_check=true.
nina.hr: Thanks — tag me and totalrewards on both tickets. I'll follow-up with payroll-UK once docs are attached. :slightly_smiling_face:
devon: Ticket submitted: https://hris.company/comp/912345 — pinged. Thanks everyone!
